<Heading

  children={"Look up queues, agents and dispositions"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/response/list/{token}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Looks up the values needed by **Transfer** and **Close**. All results are scoped to
the conversation the token belongs to.

The notification does not carry a URL for this operation — take the `responseUrl` you
received and replace `reply` with `list`.

Each item returned carries a `uuid` and a `name`. Pass the `uuid` to Transfer or
Close.
